description: A wallet's transactions since genesis, newest first, each as one decoded sentence with the coins in and out. Filter by coin, direction (in or out) and days. Page with cursor. Spam airdrops are left out. Example: { address: "0x...", limit: 10 }.

address.description: A Sui address (0x...), a SuiNS name like example.sui, or @example.

coin.description: Only transactions that moved this coin (coin type or symbol).

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous result, for the next page.

direction.description: Only coins coming in, or going out.

name: wallet_history
title: A wallet's transactions
